name: HardTalkAI
install:
sudo apt-get update -y
sudo apt-get install -y python3-venv
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip
.venv/bin/pip install -r server/requirements-dev.txt

terminals.name: server
terminals.description: FastAPI backend on :3001 (coaching engine + optional LLM). Set OPENAI_API_KEY to enable AI replies.

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: React + Vite web app on :5173 (proxies /api to :3001)
